title: Germany-based Synera, which develops AI agents to automate CAD and engineering workflows, raised $40M to expand across Europe, the US, and Asia-Pacific (Duncan Riley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Duncan Riley / SiliconANGLE: Germany-based Synera, which develops AI agents to automate CAD and engineering workflows, raised $40M to expand across Europe, the US, and Asia-Pacific — German agentic artificial intelligence startup Synera GmbH today announced that it has raised $40 million in new funding to scale …
